name: kneeling modified hindu push up
description: An easier knee-supported version of the hindu push up. The flowing dip and sweep trains the chest, shoulders and triceps and opens the spine.
instructions: Start on your knees and hands with hips high, like a pike.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Push through your arms to glide your chest up and forward, arching slightly.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up to the start.
Move smoothly and keep your core engaged.
